title: Few draw calls in raylib: one mesh and material per prop family, instanced
note: Share meshes and materials and instance repeated props so the frame stays under the draw-call ceiling on WebGL2 and ANGLE.
intent: Every DrawModel is at least one draw call, and WebGL2 pays for each one far more than a desktop driver. Load a prop's model and material once, never per instance; draw a field of the same prop with DrawMeshInstanced from one Mesh, one Material and an array of transforms built in reset from ctx-seeded positions; merge static scenery into a few large meshes. The runtime counts the whole frame at the graphics API and reports it as state().__render (drawCalls, triangles), so the ceiling is measured whatever the game reports; keep it under 1000 draw calls and a few hundred thousand triangles, and fix a frame-time spike before adding content.
port: The facet that owns a prop family owns its mesh and material; others draw it through that facet's function, never by loading a second copy.

evidence.note: Reuse geometries and materials; a material per object is the draw-call explosion; the studio counts the whole frame under __render.
studio::tag names what the following draws belong to for the draw counter (state().__render.tags).
